name: liming_bequia_dashboard
what_it_holds: 'An interactive tourism dashboard for The Liming Bequia featuring visitor arrivals, market trends, seasonal patterns, and competitive analysis' for Bequia, St. Vincent and the Grenadines (a small Eastern Caribbean island). Description notes it was 'Built with Manus' (an AI app-builder), which raises real risk the underlying visitor-arrival/market-trend figures are AI-generated/synthetic rather than sourced from CTO or St. Vincent's tourism authority. Client/server/shared folder structure but no visible README data-source citation.
why_useful: Eastern Caribbean island-level tourism data is otherwise absent from our holdings, so if the numbers are real (sourced from the St. Vincent & Grenadines Tourism Authority or CTO) this would be a novel small-market data point; but the 'Built with Manus' provenance means this needs verification before any use, so it is flagged low/unverified rather than excluded.

name: Bahamas-Ministry-of-Tourism-COVID-Survey
